sloka: विक्रमस्ते यथा विष्णो रूपं चैवाश्विनोरिव ।बुद्ध्या बृहस्पतेस्तुल्यः प्रजापतिसमो ह्यसि ।। ७.३७.५ ॥
transliteration: vikramaste yathā viṣṇo rūpaṁ caivāśvinoriva ।buddhyā bṛhaspatestulyaḥ prajāpatisamo hyasi ।। 7.37.5 ॥

translations.english: Your valor is like that of Vishnu, your beauty is like that of the Ashvins, you are equal to Brihaspati in intellect, and indeed, you are like Prajapati himself.
